name: SPT-CL J0421-4845 (Hubble)
blurb: SPT-CL J0421-4845, a massive, distant galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: sptclj04214845-hubble
story: One of the most distant of the massive galaxy clusters found by the South Pole Telescope, this crowd of galaxies is among the rarest giants known at its great distance. Hubble surveyed its members to learn how such dense places shut down the birth of stars.

claims.text: SPT-CLJ0421-4845 is one of the five highest-redshift massive SPT-SZ galaxy clusters
Selected through the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect in the South Pole Telescope survey
Among the rarest most massive clusters known at this redshift
All five clusters show clear overdensities of red galaxies
Hubble imaged the clusters to study suppression of star formation in massive cluster cores
